遠端重灌是在「執行中」的樹莓派上覆寫它自己的 SD 卡。如果中途關閉程式、斷電、 斷網或電腦睡眠，那張卡會變成寫了一半、開不了機，而且無法從遠端修復，只能把卡拿到電腦上重燒。 請先準備讀卡機或備用的 SD 卡。

Remote re-imaging overwrites the SD card of a Pi that is running. If the app is closed, power or the network drops, or the computer sleeps midway, the card ends up half-written and the Pi will not boot. It cannot be repaired remotely; the card has to be re-flashed from a computer. Prepare a card reader or a spare SD card first.

backend.新燒錄的系統通常已自動擴展；若空間比卡小很多才需要。重開機後生效。: Freshly flashed systems usually expand automatically; only needed if the space is much smaller than the card. Takes effect after a reboot.
backend.從原始碼執行時不能自動更新，請用 git pull: Cannot self-update when running from source; use git pull
backend.請輸入 IP 或主機名稱: Enter an IP address or a host name
backend.找不到 {name}：請確認名稱或 IP 沒有打錯，而且這台電腦和樹莓派在同一個: Could not find {name}: check that the name or IP is typed correctly and that this computer and the Pi are on the same network.
backend.把樹莓派變成區網裡的檔案伺服器，Windows、macOS、手機都能存取，適合接: Turns the Pi into a file server on your network that Windows, macOS and phones can open. Great with an external drive.
backend.建立共用資料夾 /srv/nas，擁有者是你登入的帳號: Create the shared folder /srv/nas, owned by the account you log in with
backend.在 /etc/samba/smb.conf 加一段 [pi-nas]（改之前會先: Add a [pi-nas] section to /etc/samba/smb.conf (a backup is made first)
backend.用這台樹莓派的登入密碼建立你的 Samba 帳號，並啟動服務: Create your Samba account with this Pi's login password and start the service
backend.TCP 445、139，UDP 137、138（只在區網使用，不要對外網開放）: TCP 445 and 139, UDP 137 and 138 (local network only, do not expose to the internet)
backend.要用密碼登入才能安裝。如果要用外接硬碟，請先把它掛載到 /srv/nas。: Requires a password login. To use an external drive, mount it at /srv/nas first.
backend.在 Windows 檔案總管的網址列輸入 \\{ip}\\pi-nas，帳號 {: In Windows Explorer's address bar enter \{ip}\pi-nas, user {user}, and the password is this Pi's login password. On macOS use smb://{ip}/pi-nas.
backend.用容器跑各種服務（Home Assistant、資料庫、網站……），不用一個個手: Run services in containers (Home Assistant, databases, websites…) without setting up each environment by hand.
backend.安裝 docker.io（apt 官方套件）並設為開機啟動: Install docker.io (official apt package) and start it at boot
backend.把你登入的帳號加進 docker 群組（重新登入後才不用 sudo）: Add your login account to the docker group (no sudo needed after you log in again)
backend.不開放任何連接埠（之後跑的容器才會開）: Opens no ports (only the containers you run later do)
backend.docker 群組的成員等同於可以取得這台樹莓派的 root 權限，只給你信任的: Members of the docker group effectively have root on this Pi. Only give it to accounts you trust.
backend.重新登入後，在終端機輸入 docker run hello-world 試試看。: After logging in again, try docker run hello-world in a terminal.
backend.有人在短時間內一直猜 SSH 密碼，就自動把他的 IP 擋掉一段時間。樹莓派要開: Automatically blocks an IP for a while when it keeps guessing SSH passwords. Especially useful when the Pi is reachable from the internet.
backend.使用內建的預設設定（保護 SSH），並設為開機啟動: Use the built-in default settings (protects SSH) and start it at boot
backend.用 sudo fail2ban-client status sshd 可以看目前: Run sudo fail2ban-client status sshd to see which IPs are blocked.
backend.樹莓派會自己安裝安全性更新，不用記得手動 apt upgrade。: The Pi installs security updates by itself, so you do not have to remember apt upgrade.
backend.寫入 /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades，每: Write /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades to check for and install security updates daily
backend.更新偶爾需要重新開機才會完全生效；它不會自動重開機。: Some updates need a reboot to fully apply; it never reboots by itself.
backend.找不到這個工作（可能已經過期）: Job not found (it may have expired).
backend.樹莓派正在更新套件（apt 被占用），請等幾分鐘再試。: The Pi is busy updating packages (apt is locked). Wait a few minutes and try again.
backend.樹莓派連不上網路，沒辦法下載套件。請確認它有連上網路。: The Pi cannot reach the internet to download packages. Check its network connection.
backend.等太久了，已經停止。樹莓派上的安裝可能還在背景繼續。: Waited too long and stopped. The installation may still be running on the Pi.
backend.這個帳號用 sudo 需要密碼，請用密碼登入再試一次。: This account needs a password for sudo. Log in with the password and try again.
backend.這個擴充套件要用密碼登入才能安裝。: This add-on can only be installed with a password login.
backend.這台樹莓派正在安裝或移除別的東西，請等它完成。: This Pi is already installing or removing something. Wait for it to finish.
backend.安裝指令失敗（代碼 {code}），詳細內容看下面的紀錄。: The command failed (code {code}). See the log below for details.
